title: This Is Where He Messed Up
description:
A slowed-down look at the ICE shooting everyone’s arguing about, and the context most clips leave out.

We break down the footage frame by frame, explain the actual legal standard (reasonable use of force), and walk through what happened before the shots: obstruction, escalation, and a firearm entering a chaotic arrest.
